facts.claim: The Domes Resorts group's romance page says its professionals deliver fully personalised wedding planning on the Greek Islands or the Algarve, and offers exchanging vows 'with a ceremony on the Domes pier'. The page's Domes Miramare entry describes speedboat trips to Corfu Old Town, dining to an orchestral performance and spa rituals, but does not itself mention weddings.

Domes Miramare, a Luxury Collection Resort, Corfu is an adults-only (16+) beachfront resort in Moraitika, Corfu, set in a two-century-old olive grove with 650 metres of seafront, 182 rooms, suites and villas, 3 restaurants including a MICHELIN-starred venue, 4 bars, a private pier and speedboat. Built by the Onassis family in the late 1960s. Its homepage does not mention weddings.

King George, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Athens (kinggeorgeathens.com redirects to its Marriott page) dates from 1930, sits on Syntagma Square, has 102 rooms and suites including a Penthouse Suite with a private outdoor pool overlooking the Acropolis, and lists 'Meeting Space' and an events page. The overview page does not mention weddings; the events page was not read within the time limit.
